title: Spectrum DM435MT 4-in-1 Petrol Multi-Tool
description_html:
Spectrum DM435MT 4-in-1 Petrol Multi-Tool

Tackle a wide range of garden maintenance tasks with just one powerful machine. The Spectrum DM435MT 4-in-1 Petrol Multi-Tool combines four essential garden tools into a single, versatile unit, helping to reduce the cost, storage space, and maintenance associated with owning multiple powered machines.

Powered by one reliable petrol engine, the DM435MT quickly converts between a grass trimmer, brushcutter, long-reach hedge trimmer, and pole pruner, making it an ideal choice for maintaining lawns, hedges, overgrown areas, and trees.

Designed for comfort and ease of use, the machine is well balanced with every attachment and features an ergonomic loop handle and single-shoulder harness for excellent control and reduced operator fatigue.

The practical split-shaft design makes the Spectrum DM435MT easy to transport and store, while allowing fast, tool-free changes between attachments. A robust locking mechanism keeps each attachment securely in place, providing safe, reliable performance during operation.

Grass Trimmer Attachment

The grass trimmer is ideal for edging lawns and clearing long grass around borders, fences, and obstacles.

  • 43cm cutting width for fast coverage
  • Durable 2mm nylon cutting line for tackling heavier grass and weeds
  • Convenient bump-feed head for quick line advancement

Brushcutter Attachment

For tougher vegetation, simply switch to the brushcutter attachment.

  • 25.5cm three-tooth metal blade
  • Ideal for clearing dense weeds, nettles, brambles, and established scrub
  • Built to handle demanding clearing work with ease

Long-Reach Hedge Trimmer Attachment

Maintain tall hedges safely from the ground without the need for ladders.

  • 40cm dual-action cutting blade
  • 25mm tooth spacing for cutting thicker, mature hedge growth
  • 180° adjustable cutting head for trimming the tops and sides of hedges at a variety of angles

Pole Pruner Attachment

The pole pruner makes pruning high branches safer and more convenient.

  • 25cm chainsaw bar for efficient branch cutting
  • Automatic chain lubrication for smooth performance and extended chain life
  • Ideal for removing overhanging or light-blocking branches while keeping both feet safely on the ground

Important: Use 10W30 lawnmower engine oil (or an equivalent light engine oil) to lubricate the chain. Do not use standard chainsaw chain oil, as its higher viscosity is designed for pressure-fed oiling systems. The Spectrum DM435MT pole pruner uses a gravity-fed lubrication system, so a lighter oil is required to flow correctly and provide effective lubrication to the chain and guide bar during operation.

The Spectrum DM435MT is an excellent all-in-one solution for homeowners seeking versatile, reliable garden equipment capable of handling everything from routine lawn edging to heavy-duty vegetation clearance and tree pruning.
